description: Test whether Ser/Thr-rich O-mannosylation regions discriminate cell-wall from plasma-membrane GPI proteins better than the omega-minus dibasic rule, and place Adg2; also identify the remaining top-tier S. pombe hits
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu

KD=dict(A=1.8,R=-4.5,N=-3.5,D=-3.5,C=2.5,Q=-3.5,E=-3.5,G=-0.4,H=-3.2,I=4.5,L=3.8,K=-3.9,M=1.9,
        F=2.8,P=-1.6,S=-0.8,T=-0.7,W=-0.9,Y=-1.3,V=4.2)
CHARGED=set("DEKR"); SMALL=set("GASTCNDV")
OM={'G':2.,'A':2.,'S':2.,'N':2.,'D':2.,'C':1.5,'T':.5,'V':0.}

def chd(seq,maxlook=45,min_kd=1.0):
    n=len(seq); best=None
    for L in range(5,min(maxlook,n)+1):
        suf=seq[n-L:]
        if any(c in CHARGED for c in suf): continue
        m=np.mean([KD[c] for c in suf if c in KD])
        if m>=min_kd: best=(n-L,L,m)
    return best

def gpi(seq):
    n=len(seq); h=chd(seq)
    if h is None: return None
    p,L,kd=h; cands=[]
    for w in range(max(0,p-15),p-6):
        a=seq[w]
        if a not in OM or w+2>=n: continue
        s=OM[a]+(0.5 if seq[w+1] not in "PW" else -1.)+(1.5 if seq[w+2] in SMALL else -1.)\
          +(1.5 if L>=10 else (1. if L>=8 else -1.))+(1.5 if kd>=2. else 1.)\
          +(0.5 if sum(c in CHARGED for c in seq[w+3:p])<=1 else -0.5)
        cands.append((round(s,2),w+1))
    if not cands: return None
    cands.sort(key=lambda x:(-x[0],x[1]))
    return dict(score=cands[0][0],omega=cands[0][1],tail_len=L,tail_kd=round(kd,2))

uf=lambda a:"".join(requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=60).text.strip().split("\n")[1:])

def st_metrics(seq,sp_end,omega):
    """Ser/Thr statistics of the mature ectodomain (after SP cleavage, before omega)."""
    mat=seq[sp_end:omega-1]
    if len(mat)<40: return None
    st=np.array([1 if c in "ST" else 0 for c in mat],float)
    frac=st.mean()
    W=50
    if len(mat)>=W:
        cs=np.concatenate([[0],np.cumsum(st)])
        wins=(cs[W:]-cs[:-W])/W
        best=float(wins.max()); nhi=int((wins>=0.40).sum())
    else:
        best=frac; nhi=0
    # longest run where >=60% of a 20-residue window is S/T
    return dict(mat_len=len(mat),ST_frac=round(frac,3),ST_max50=round(best,3),n_win_ge40pct=nhi)

# mature-start estimate: UniProt SIGNAL ends, hard-coded where known, else 20
SETS=[("P22146","Sc Gas1","plasma_membrane",20),("P32329","Sc Yps1","plasma_membrane",22),
      ("Q05031","Sc Dfg5","plasma_membrane",19),
      ("P53301","Sc Crh1","cell_wall",19),("P43497","Sc Cwp2","cell_wall",19),
      ("P28319","Sc Cwp1","cell_wall",18),("Q01589","Sc Sed1","cell_wall",18),
      ("P32768","Sc Sag1","cell_wall",22),("P27654","Sc Tip1","cell_wall",18),
      ("O13854","Sp Adg2","query",19),("S9W079","S.cryo ortholog","query_ortholog",18),
      ("S9R663","S.octo ortholog","query_ortholog",26),
      ("O13960","Sp Ecm33","sp_unknown",21),("Q9UR09","Sp Psu1","sp_unknown",20),
      ("Q9P378","Sp Gas1","sp_unknown",20),("Q92340","Sp Shu1","sp_unknown",20),
      ("O94549","Sp SPCC1322.10","sp_unknown",20)]
rows=[]
for acc,lab,grp,spend in SETS:
    s=uf(acc); g=gpi(s)
    if not g: continue
    m=st_metrics(s,spend,g["omega"])
    if not m: continue
    rows.append(dict(acc=acc,protein=lab,group=grp,length=len(s),omega=g["omega"],**m))
D=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print("="*78,"\nSer/Thr content of the mature ectodomain (SP cleavage -> omega)\n","="*78)
print(D.to_string(index=False))

pm=D[D.group=="plasma_membrane"]; cw=D[D.group=="cell_wall"]
for col in ["ST_frac","ST_max50"]:
    u,p=mannwhitneyu(cw[col],pm[col],alternative='greater')
    # rank-biserial effect size
    r=1-2*u/(len(cw)*len(pm))
    print(f"\n{col}: cell wall median {cw[col].median():.3f} (n={len(cw)}) vs PM median {pm[col].median():.3f} (n={len(pm)})"
          f"  Mann-Whitney U={u}, one-sided p={p:.4f}, rank-biserial r={-r:.2f}")
adg2=D[D.protein=="Sp Adg2"].iloc[0]
print(f"\nAdg2: ST_frac={adg2.ST_frac}, ST_max50={adg2.ST_max50}, windows>=40% S/T: {adg2.n_win_ge40pct}, mature length {adg2.mat_len}")
print("Where does Adg2 fall? ST_frac percentile among cell-wall set:",
      round(100*(cw.ST_frac<adg2.ST_frac).mean(),0),"%; among PM set:",round(100*(pm.ST_frac<adg2.ST_frac).mean(),0),"%")

print("\n","="*78,"\nIdentify remaining top-tier S. pombe hits\n","="*78)
r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",
    params={"query":"(gene:SPBC1E8.05 OR gene:SPBC215.13) AND organism_id:284812",
            "fields":"accession,id,gene_names,protein_name,length,ft_signal,ft_lipid,cc_subcellular_location",
            "format":"tsv","size":10},timeout=120)
for ln in r.text.strip().split("\n"): print(ln[:300])

# ---------------- figure
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.8))
order=["plasma_membrane","cell_wall","sp_unknown","query_ortholog","query"]
lab={"plasma_membrane":"Sc PM-retained","cell_wall":"Sc cell wall","sp_unknown":"Sp GPI proteins",
     "query_ortholog":"Adg2 orthologs","query":"Adg2"}
cols={"plasma_membrane":"#2b6cb0","cell_wall":"#dd6b20","sp_unknown":"#718096",
      "query_ortholog":"#38a169","query":"#c53030"}
for i,g in enumerate(order):
    sub=D[D.group==g]
    if not len(sub): continue
    xs=np.full(len(sub),i)+np.linspace(-.16,.16,len(sub))
    ax[0].scatter(xs,sub.ST_frac,s=90,color=cols[g],edgecolor="k",lw=.6,zorder=3)
    for x,(_,rr) in zip(xs,sub.iterrows()):
        ax[0].annotate(rr.protein.replace("Sc ","").replace("Sp ","").replace(" ortholog",""),
                       (x,rr.ST_frac),fontsize=6.5,ha="center",va="bottom")
ax[0].set_xticks(range(len(order))); ax[0].set_xticklabels([lab[g] for g in order],fontsize=8)
ax[0].set_ylabel("Ser + Thr fraction of mature ectodomain")
ax[0].set_title("Ser/Thr content separates cell-wall from\nPM-retained GPI proteins; Adg2 sits with the wall set")
ax[0].grid(axis="y",alpha=.3)

x=np.arange(len(D)); Ds=D.sort_values("ST_max50")
ax[1].barh(range(len(Ds)),Ds.ST_max50,color=[cols[g] for g in Ds.group],edgecolor="k",lw=.5)
ax[1].set_yticks(range(len(Ds))); ax[1].set_yticklabels(Ds.protein,fontsize=7)
ax[1].axvline(0.40,color="k",ls="--",lw=1)
ax[1].set_xlabel("maximum Ser+Thr fraction in a 50-residue window")
ax[1].set_title("Peak Ser/Thr density (dashed line = 40%)")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
